Hello Early Expressions team,

I'm Janani, and I build websites for play schools and preschools in Chennai. I was looking at earlyexpressions.in this week. On a phone, your homepage opens as a long list of plain bullet-point links and phone numbers, and the first photo only appears after a full screen of menu. Most parents look up a play school on their phone, so that first screen matters.

So I rebuilt it, using your own photos and details. Here's how it looks today and how it could look, on a computer and on a phone:
A:
See it live: https://jananiporkodi.github.io/revamp/early-expressions/
Open it on your phone and scroll slowly. As parents scroll, they walk from your graduation day into a happy classroom, first letters at the blue table and a flower kolam, then on to your programmes, after-school classes and a visit button.

Why this matters now: AI search. More and more people skip Google and simply ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google's AI answers for “a play school in Madipakkam”. These assistants recommend the businesses whose websites clearly tell them who you are, where you are and what you offer. Right now earlyexpressions.in doesn't give these tools your business details in a form they can read, like most websites built a few years ago. Your new website is built for it: your details are written in the standard format AI tools read (schema.org), it has a clear question-and-answer section, and an llms.txt file made for AI assistants.

  • Call and WhatsApp buttons on every screen
  • Basic Google setup, so parents searching for play schools in Madipakkam can find you
  • Two rounds of changes: new photos, prices, wording, anything you like
  • One month of free fixes after launch

  • Payment: half to start, half when the site goes live
